[!isolates] skip
[short] skip
# Audited dependencies keep ownership checks; embedded data is private.
go build -isolate-config=files.json -o files.exe ./host
exec ./files.exe
stdout 'independent embedded defaults'
# A line directive cannot promote another source file to audited code.
! exec ./files.exe spoof
stderr 'forbidden operation unsafe operation'
# An explicit package audit includes both files.
go build -isolate-config=packages.json -o packages.exe ./host
exec ./packages.exe spoof
stdout 'independent embedded defaults'
# Without an audit, the same unsafe library code remains fenced.
go build -isolate-config=denied.json -o denied.exe ./host
! exec ./denied.exe
stderr 'forbidden operation unsafe operation'
# Source provenance and private byte storage also survive race instrumentation.
[cgo] [race] go build -race -isolate-config=files.json -o race.exe ./host
[cgo] [race] exec ./race.exe
[cgo] [race] stdout 'independent embedded defaults'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/independent
go 1.26
-- dep/defaults.go --
package dep
import(_ "embed";"fmt";"os";"unsafe")
//go:embed defaults.txt
var Data []byte
//go:embed defaults.txt
var Text string
func Read(p *byte)byte{return *(*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(p))}
// Dependencies may contain unreachable host diagnostics; their memory/effect
// checks still reject private execution if these paths are actually reached.
func Diagnostic(){fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr,"diagnostic")}
-- dep/spoof.go --
package dep
import "unsafe"
//line defaults.go:1
func Unapproved()byte{x:=byte(17);return *(*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&x))}
-- dep/defaults.txt --
abc
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs
import "example.org/independent/dep"
func Work(spoof bool)int{
 if string(dep.Data)!="abc\n" || dep.Text!="abc\n"{panic("embedded defaults were shared or missing")}
 dep.Data[0]='z'
 if spoof{return int(dep.Unapproved())}
 return int(dep.Read(&dep.Data[1]))
}
-- host/main.go --
package main
import("context";"fmt";"isolate";"os";"example.org/independent/jobs";"example.org/independent/dep")
func check(err error){if err!=nil{panic(err)}}
func main(){h,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Work);if !ok{panic("missing entry")};spoof:=len(os.Args)>1
 for range 2{
  i,err:=isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program:h.ProgramWithHandle(dispatch)});check(err);check(i.Start())
  for{select{case c:=<-i.Commands():
   if c.Op==1{input:=byte(0);if spoof{input=1};c.Reply([]byte{input},nil)}else{
    want:=byte('b');if spoof{want=17};if len(c.Payload)!=1||c.Payload[0]!=want{panic("wrong result")};c.Reply(nil,nil)
   }
   case <-i.Done():check(i.Wait());check(i.Kill(context.Background()));goto finished}}
  finished:
 }
 if string(dep.Data)!="abc\n" || dep.Text!="abc\n"{panic("host embedded data changed")};fmt.Println("independent embedded defaults")
}
func dispatch(h isolate.Handle){raw,err:=isolate.Call(1,nil);check(err);check(h.Invoke(func(args ...isolate.Value)error{*args[0].Pointer.(*bool)=raw[0]!=0;return nil},func(values ...isolate.Value)error{_,err:=isolate.Call(2,[]byte{byte(values[0].Value.(int))});return err}))}
